settings_schema.name: google_analytics_enabled
settings_schema.label: Enable Google Analytics
settings_schema.help_text: Enable Google Analytics on your storefront.

settings_schema.name: google_analytics_measurement_id
settings_schema.label: Google Analytics Measurement ID
settings_schema.help_text: Your GA4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). The app does nothing until this is set.

settings_schema.name: google_adwords_conversion_enabled
settings_schema.label: Enable Google Ads Conversion Tracking
settings_schema.help_text: Sends a conversion event to Google Ads when an order is completed.

settings_schema.name: google_adwords_conversion_id
settings_schema.label: Google Ads Conversion ID
settings_schema.help_text: Including the AW- prefix, e.g. AW-123456789. Required when Google Ads Conversion Tracking is enabled.

settings_schema.name: google_adwords_conversion_label
settings_schema.label: Google Ads Conversion Label
settings_schema.help_text: Required when Google Ads Conversion Tracking is enabled.

settings_schema.name: google_analytics_debug_mode
settings_schema.label: Enable Debug Mode
settings_schema.help_text: Sends debug_mode so events appear in GA4 DebugView in real time.

settings_schema.name: google_analytics_skip_test_orders
settings_schema.label: Skip Test Orders
settings_schema.help_text: Do not send purchase or conversion events for test orders.
